_comment: One object per eval run, newest last. Each references an eval in registry.json by `eval`. `metrics` keys must match that eval's metric keys. `date` is the run date (YYYY-MM-DD); `run_id` is unique within an eval. The /evals hub plots each metric across the runs of its eval, so appending a run here is all it takes to extend the trend graphs. Keep `counts` for the raw numbers behind rate metrics. Optional `scorecard` links this run's own report page (e.g. /evals/scorecard?run=<run_id>, served from eval/golden_scorecard_<run_id>.html); the hub lists one link per run, falling back to the eval's scorecard path + ?run= when absent.

runs.label: Golden set v1
runs.notes: First full golden run: 50 personas, top-10 ranked each. Scored by the LLM-judge pre-labels in golden_matches_scored.csv. See the full scorecard for per-row verdicts.
